items.title: there be 的存在意义与主谓一致
items.brief: there 只是引导词，be 与后置的真正主语一致

concept.summary: there be 表示“某处存在某物”，there 是引导词不是主语，真正的主语是 be 后面的名词，因此 be 的单复数由该名词决定。只有一个名词时按该名词定；并列名词时按就近原则，与最靠近 be 的那个名词一致。

sections.p: there 在这里没有“那里”的实义，只占主语位置引出后面的名词。因为主语后置，句子真正的主语永远在 be 之后，这一点决定了后面所有的单复数与疑问形式。
bullets: there 不能替换成 it 或 they：× It is a book on the desk.
疑问句把 be 提前：Is there a bank near here?
简答与反意疑问都用 there：Yes, there is. / There is a problem, isn't there?
存在义只能由 be 承担，不能换成 have

sections.p: 只有一个名词时直接按该名词定单复数；出现并列名词时，be 只与最近的那个名词一致，这就是 there be 句型的就近原则。
bullets: 单数主语：There is a book on the shelf.
复数主语：There are two books on the shelf.
不可数主语：There is some milk in the fridge.
就近原则：There is a pen and two books on the desk. / There are two books and a pen on the desk.
数量短语按量词定：There are three pieces of advice in the letter.

sections.p: there be 引出的是“一个尚未确定的存在物”，所以后面通常接不定指名词。若名词已被 the、物主代词或上下文确定为唯一对象，应改用主系表结构。
bullets: 通常接 a/an/some/many/two 等不定限定词
× There is the dictionary you wanted on the shelf. → The dictionary you wanted is on the shelf.
抽象名词同样可用：There is no doubt about his ability.
地点状语可省略，但存在义仍完整：There is a God.

examples.en: There is a small café on the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 街角有一家小咖啡馆。
examples.note: 真正的主语是 a small café，单数，be 用 is。

examples.en: There have a small café on the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 街角有一家小咖啡馆。
examples.note: 存在义只能由 there be 承担，have 表所属，须有真正的主语，不能进入 there 结构。

examples.en: There are two books and a pen on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有两本书和一支笔。
examples.note: 最近的名词是 two books，复数，be 用 are。

examples.en: There is a pen and two books on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一支笔和两本书。
examples.note: 就近原则，be 与最近的 a pen 一致用 is。

examples.en: There is two books and a pen on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一支笔和两本书。
examples.note: 最近的名词是 two books，为复数，be 必须用 are。

examples.en: There is some interesting information in the report.
examples.zh: 报告里有一些有趣的信息。
examples.note: information 不可数，be 用单数 is。

pitfalls.wrong: There have many reasons for the change.
pitfalls.right: There are many reasons for the change.
pitfalls.why: there 结构的存在义只能由 be 承担；have 表示“拥有”，必须有真正的主语。

pitfalls.wrong: There is three apples in the basket.
pitfalls.right: There are three apples in the basket.
pitfalls.why: be 要与后置的真正主语 three apples 保持一致，复数是 are。

pitfalls.wrong: There are a table and four chairs in the room.
pitfalls.right: There is a table and four chairs in the room.
pitfalls.why: 并列主语按就近原则，be 只与最近的 a table 一致，用 is。

contrast.withTitle: there be 与 have 的区别及非谓语形式
contrast.diff: 本点只管 there be 内部谁决定谓语；与 have 的分工以及 there being / there to be 的非谓语形式另作一点处理。

concept.mnemonic: there 是引子，be 看后面；一个看名词，几个看最近。

core: there 是引导词，真正的主语在 be 之后
be 的单复数由后置名词决定，不由 there 决定
并列名词按就近原则，与最近的名词一致
存在义只能用 be，不能用 have
there be 后接不定指名词，特指名词改用主系表结构
review.trigger: 看到 there ___ + 名词 → 先数最近那个名词 → 再定 is 还是 are

quickCheck.q: There ___ a pen and two books on the desk. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: is，就近原则与 a pen 一致。

quickCheck.q: There have a book on the desk. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 存在义须用 there be，have 不能进入 there 结构。

quickCheck.q: There is a book on the desk. 的主语是哪个词？

drills.stem: ___ a pharmacy and two supermarkets on this street.
drills.explain: 并列主语按就近原则，be 只与最近的 a pharmacy 一致，用单数 is。
drills.trap: There are 会被后面的 two supermarkets 带走，忽略就近原则；There have 则混淆了存在与所属。

drills.stem: There ___ some milk and two eggs in the fridge.
drills.hint: 看紧挨着 be 的那个名词。
drills.explain: 最近的名词是 some milk，不可数，be 用单数 is；后面的 two eggs 不参与一致。

drills.stem: There have many students waiting outside the office.
drills.answer: There are many students waiting outside the office.
accept: There are many students waiting outside the office.
drills.explain: 句子表存在而非所属，须用 there be；主语 many students 为复数，be 用 are。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: There is a map and two posters on the wall.
drills.explain: 按就近原则，be 与最近的 a map 一致用 is；地点状语 on the wall 置于句末。

drills.stem: 桌上有一本书和两支笔。
drills.answer: There is a book and two pens on the table.
drills.explain: 存在句用 there be，并列主语按就近原则与 a book 一致用 is；钢笔用复数 pens。

drills.stem: There ___ a number of problems with the original plan.
drills.explain: a number of 意为“许多”，中心词是复数名词 problems，be 用 are；the number of 才表数量、用单数。
drills.trap: is 只看 a number 的字面单数形式，忽略了 a number of 后接复数名词这一固定结构。

items.title: there be 的时态与情态形式
items.brief: 时态与情态全部由 be 的变化承担

concept.summary: there be 的时态与情态一律通过 be 的变形实现：was/were 表过去，will be 表将来，have/has been 表现在完成，had been 表过去完成。情态动词后固定用 be 原形，不能用 is 或 are。be 后面的名词决定单复数这条规则在所有形式中都不变。

sections.p: 先确定时间参照，再把 be 变成相应形式，最后按后置名词定单复数。三步顺序不能颠倒，因为单复数检查只发生在最后一步。
bullets: 一般过去：There was a storm last night. / There were no seats left.
一般将来：There will be a meeting tomorrow. / There is going to be a change.
现在完成：There have been three complaints so far.
过去完成：There had been no rain for weeks before the fire.
将来完成：There will have been a full review by June.（少用但成立）

sections.p: 情态动词后面只能接动词原形，所以在 there 结构中一律是 there + 情态 + be。要表推测的完成意义时用 there + 情态 + have been。
bullets: There must be a mistake in the invoice.
There may be delays on the northern line.
There can be no doubt about her commitment.
There must have been an accident at the junction.
否定与疑问同样只变 be 或情态：There isn't any milk. / Is there any chance of a refund?

sections.h: 与 seem/appear/used to 的组合
sections.p: seem、appear、happen、used to 后面接 to be 时，主谓一致落在这些动词上，判断依据仍是后面的名词。这类结构在阅读中出现频率很高。
bullets: There seems to be a problem with the printer.
There seem to be two possible explanations.
There appears to have been a misunderstanding.
There used to be a bakery on this corner.
There happened to be a doctor on the train.

examples.en: There will be a staff meeting next Monday.
examples.zh: 下周一有一场员工会议。
examples.note: 将来存在用 there will be，be 保持原形。

examples.en: There have been several complaints about the noise.
examples.zh: 关于噪音已经有好几起投诉了。
examples.note: 现在完成形式 have been，与复数主语 complaints 一致。

examples.en: There will have a staff meeting next Monday.
examples.zh: 下周一有一场员工会议。
examples.note: 将来存在由 will be 表达，have 不能出现在 there 结构中。

examples.en: There must be a simpler explanation for this.
examples.zh: 这件事一定有一个更简单的解释。
examples.note: 情态动词 must 后接 be 原形，表肯定推测。

examples.en: There must is a simpler explanation for this.
examples.zh: 这件事一定有一个更简单的解释。
examples.note: 情态动词后必须用动词原形 be，不能用 is。

examples.en: There seems to be a misunderstanding between the two sides.
examples.zh: 双方之间似乎存在误解。
examples.note: 真正的主语 a misunderstanding 为单数，seem 用单数形式。

examples.en: There seem to be a misunderstanding between the two sides.
examples.zh: 双方之间似乎存在误解。
examples.note: seem 的单复数要与后置主语 a misunderstanding 一致，须用 seems。

examples.en: There used to be a bakery on this corner.
examples.zh: 这个街角过去有一家面包店。
examples.note: used to be 表过去存在，be 用原形。

pitfalls.wrong: There will have a test next week.
pitfalls.right: There will be a test next week.
pitfalls.why: 将来存在由 will be 承担，have 不能进入 there 结构，否则既无主语又改变语义。

pitfalls.wrong: There must have a reason for his absence.
pitfalls.right: There must be a reason for his absence.
pitfalls.why: 情态动词后只能接动词原形，表推测时用 must be；must have done 只用于对过去动作的推测。

pitfalls.wrong: There were a lot of traffic this morning.
pitfalls.right: There was a lot of traffic this morning.
pitfalls.why: traffic 是不可数名词，be 必须用单数 was。

contrast.withTitle: there be 的存在意义与主谓一致
contrast.diff: 本点只把 be 换成不同时态与情态；谁决定单复数这条规则不变，仍看后置名词。

concept.mnemonic: 时态情态都压在 be 上；情态后面只认 be，不认 is。

core: 过去 was/were、将来 will be、现在完成 have/has been、过去完成 had been
情态动词后一律用 be 原形：there must/may/can be
对过去的推测用 there must have been
seem/appear/used to 后接 to be，一致关系落在 seem 上
任何形式下 be 的单复数仍由后置名词决定
review.trigger: 看到 there 后要表时间或推测 → 先定时态/情态 → 再检查后置名词的单复数

quickCheck.a: There will be a lecture tomorrow.

quickCheck.q: There must ___ a reason. 填什么？
There seem to be a problem. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 真正的主语 a problem 是单数，须用 seems。

drills.stem: ___ a sharp rise in house prices over the past two years.
drills.explain: over the past two years 要求现在完成时，主语 a sharp rise 为单数，故用 there has been。
drills.trap: There have been 忽略主语中心词 rise 是单数，被后面的 prices 带偏。

drills.stem: There ___ (be) no rain in this region for six months before the fire broke out.
drills.hint: 时间参照是火灾发生之前的那六个月。
drills.explain: “六个月没下雨”发生在火灾之前，属于过去的过去，须用过去完成时 there had been。

drills.stem: There will have a new library on campus next year.
drills.answer: There will be a new library on campus next year.
accept: There will be a new library on campus next year.
drills.explain: 表将来存在须用 there will be，have 不能进入 there 结构，且 have 在此没有主语。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: There must have been a misunderstanding.
drills.explain: 对过去情况的肯定推测用 there must have been，be 变为完成形式 been。

drills.stem: 明天下午将有一场讲座。
drills.answer: There will be a lecture tomorrow afternoon.
drills.explain: 将来存在用 there will be 或 there is going to be，两者都不能换成 have；lecture 为单数，be 用原形。

drills.stem: There ___ to be several problems with the new system.
drills.explain: seem 的主语是后置的 several problems，为复数，须用复数形式 seem；seem 作系动词一般不用进行时。
drills.trap: seems 只看到 to be 就按单数处理，忽略真正的主语是 several problems。

items.title: there be 与 have 的区别及非谓语形式
items.brief: 存在与拥有分工不同，非谓语另有专用形式

concept.summary: 判定标准看主语：句子回答“某处存在着什么”、主语位置没有具体对象时用 there be；回答“谁拥有什么”、主语是具体的人或物时用 have。there be 只能作谓语，需要作主语、宾语或状语时改用非谓语形式——介词后和独立主格用 there being，作主语或动词宾语用 there to be。

sections.h: 存在与拥有：看主语是谁
sections.p: 两种结构不能互换的根源在于主语。there be 的主语后置，句首的 there 只是占位；have 前面必须是真正的所有者。句子意思落在“存在”还是“归属”，由此决定。
bullets: 存在：There is a small library on the second floor.
拥有：Our school has a small library on the second floor.
人物所有权只能用 have：× There is a brother of mine in Canada.
there be 不能再带另一个主语：× Our school there is a library.

sections.h: 非谓语：there being 与 there to be
sections.p: there 结构不能作主语或宾语，因为 it 已占住主语位置的是形式主语，而 there 本身没有格。需要非谓语时，there 与 be 一起变成 there being 或 there to be，选择依据是前面的词要求动名词还是不定式。
bullets: 介词后与独立主格用 there being：She insisted on there being a formal vote.
独立主格表原因：There being no bus at that hour, we walked home.
expect/want/consider/intend/hate/prefer 后用 there to be：I expect there to be no objections.
deny/mind/insist on 后用 there being：He denied there being any problem.
完成式用 there having been：There having been no reply, we cancelled the order.

sections.h: there be 的固定扩展句式
sections.p: 这些句式已经整体化，看到前半截就能确定后面接什么形式，不需要再作结构分析。
bullets: There is no point in doing sth.（做某事没有意义）
There is no denying that...（不可否认……）
There is no need to do sth.（没有必要做某事）
There is said/reported/believed to be...（据说/据报道存在……）

examples.en: There is a small library on the second floor.
examples.zh: 二楼有一个小图书馆。
examples.note: 回答“存在什么”，主语后置，句首用 there。

examples.en: Our school has a small library on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我们学校二楼有一个小图书馆。
examples.note: 回答“谁拥有”，主语 our school 在前，用 have。

examples.en: She insisted on there to be a formal vote.
examples.zh: 她坚持要进行一次正式投票。
examples.note: 介词 on 后要求动名词，there 的非谓语形式是 there being，不能用 there to be。

examples.en: There being no bus at that hour, we decided to walk home.
examples.zh: 那个时间没有公交车，我们决定走回家。
examples.note: there being 构成独立主格，作原因状语。

examples.en: I expect there to be no objections to the proposal.
examples.zh: 我预计不会有人反对这项提议。
examples.note: expect 后接不定式，there 结构用 there to be。

examples.en: There is no denying that the plan carries risks.
examples.zh: 不可否认这个计划有风险。
examples.note: there is no denying that 是固定句式，后面接完整从句。

examples.en: There is no point to argue with him about it.
examples.zh: 为这件事和他争论没有意义。
examples.note: no point 后固定接 in + 动名词，应改为 no point in arguing。

pitfalls.wrong: There has a beautiful garden behind the house.
pitfalls.right: There is a beautiful garden behind the house.
pitfalls.why: 存在义只能由 be 承担；have 表所属，必须有真正的主语，不能放在 there 之后。

pitfalls.wrong: He denied there to be any problem with the data.
pitfalls.right: He denied there being any problem with the data.
pitfalls.why: deny 后接动名词，there 的非谓语形式相应取 there being。

pitfalls.wrong: There is no point to complain about the result.
pitfalls.right: There is no point in complaining about the result.
pitfalls.why: no point 后是固定结构 in + 动名词，介词 in 不能省，动词也不能用不定式。

contrast.diff: there be 句型主语后置、只表存在；it 句型用形式主语占位，后面接的是真正的主语从句或不定式，表评价或事实。

concept.mnemonic: 存在 there be，拥有 have；介词后面 there being，动词后面 there to be。

core: 存在用 there be，拥有用 have，判断依据是主语是谁
there be 不能与另一个主语并存，也不能用 have 代替 be
介词后与独立主格用 there being
expect/want/consider 后用 there to be
固定句式：no point in doing / no denying that / no need to do
review.trigger: 看到 there 要放在介词后或动词后 → 立刻换 there being / there to be → 再核对前面的词要求哪种形式

quickCheck.q: “我们学校有一个大操场”能用 there be 吗？
quickCheck.a: 可以，There is a large playground in our school.；若强调学校拥有该设施也可用 Our school has...

quickCheck.q: insist on there ___ a vote. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: being，介词 on 后接动名词。

quickCheck.q: There is no point ___ (argue). 填什么？
quickCheck.a: in arguing，固定结构 in + 动名词。

drills.stem: ___ no point in arguing with someone who refuses to listen.
drills.explain: no point in doing 是 there be 的固定扩展句式，表“做某事没有意义”，句首用 there is。
drills.trap: It is 是形式主语结构，虽然也能带评价形容词，但 no point in doing 已固定为 there be 句式。

drills.stem: The company expects there ___ (be) a gradual recovery next year.
drills.explain: expect 要求不定式作宾语，there 结构相应变为 there to be，不能保留谓语形式 there is。

drills.stem: She insisted on there to be an independent review of the case.
drills.answer: She insisted on there being an independent review of the case.
accept: She insisted on there being an independent review of the case.
drills.explain: insist on 的 on 是介词，后面必须接动名词，there 结构取 there being 而不是 there to be。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: There being no taxi available, we walked home.
drills.explain: there being 引导独立主格作原因状语，主句主语 we 与它不同，构成完整的复合结构。

drills.stem: 这座房子后面有一个美丽的花园。
drills.answer: There is a beautiful garden behind the house.
drills.explain: 句子表存在而非所属，须用 there be；主语 a beautiful garden 为单数，be 用 is。

drills.stem: He was late because of ___ no direct bus to the airport.
drills.explain: because of 的 of 是介词，后面接动名词，there 结构取 there being，构成介词宾语。
drills.trap: there to be 只用于 expect/want 等动词后，介词后用错形式；there is 是谓语形式，不能作介词宾语。
